sn-infographic 2026.8.19

- Adds detailed input parameter extraction rules, including inline KV parsing, keyword recognition, and fallback defaults.
- Expands supported triggers to include multiple English and Chinese phrases for infographic/visualization requests.
- Clarifies and documents the dual-agent architecture (Main Agent + Worker Agent) and their respective responsibilities.
- Outlines explicit workflow for parameter handling and user interaction, with new, precise handling of edge cases.
- Enhances documentation on API configuration and error handling (e.g., for missing or invalid API keys).
- Improves prompt evaluation and expansion logic, supporting flexible generation modes and multiple quality review rounds.
